Requests:
[t0] Can you tell me what personal information you hold about me? This is an information request, not a request to erase it.
[t1] Can you verify that my account was deleted? A search result with a similar email belongs to someone else, so please do not treat that record as mine.
[t2] Could you send me a copy of the information held on my account? I still use it, so please don't delete or change anything.
[t3] Hi, I haven’t used this account in years and would like it closed. Please remove the profile and the personal details attached to it.
[t4] I am asking you to remove my account and the personal information linked to it. Please apply the correct treatment to records covered by the request. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
